executionRules: Authenticate the contract, recipes, new helper/controls source and immutable original provider closure before importing or calling original mathematics.
Execute groups1..12 once in listed order; stop immediately on first assertion, source, accounting, exception-identity or resource mismatch. No retry or full reference call.
Each group creates one fresh cache and new exact builtin Context instances from the listed literal templates. Keep each instance alive so its flags persist naturally across that group calls.
A contextInstance selects that same actual active Context with setcontext; it is not copied or flag-cleared between wrapper calls. Restore the prior caller Context in finally.

Baseline calls run once each BEFORE wrapper calls, each in its own independent literal-template Context, and do not warm the cache. Save actual result.as_tuple/exception type and full post-flags; restore the prior Context afterward.

Each wrapper receives a recording forwarding delegate that calls the unchanged original exactly once and records return/raise identity and full flags. Direct baselines call original directly; both count toward72.
No Decimal arithmetic, normalization, float conversion or support-radius formula exists in fixtures, comparisons, keys, snapshots, timing or accounting. Only the original helper performs arithmetic.
A capacity bypass is also a lookup miss for eligible data: misses includes capacity misses. type/context bypasses are not eligible lookup misses.
Aggregate actual wrapper/direct/delegated counts outside per-request cache stats so group9.clear cannot erase actual work.
Construct fixtures with the exact declared builtin containers and Decimal string representations; only explicitly marked leaves use the test Decimal subclass.

Every stored key is typed length-delimited bytes covering function/source identity, full argument tuples/as_tuple representations and full Context settings/traps/incoming flags. A hash alone is not a key.
All successful original return comparisons use exact Decimal type/as_tuple; Decimal numeric equality alone is insufficient. Do not independently derive expected support radius.
Full reference/evaluate/QP/World/fixture-function/trig/production calls are0 in this primitive gate.
